title: I Can't Sleep: Relaxing Facts to Fall Asleep To
author: Benjamin Boster
description: Trouble sleeping? I Can't Sleep is a sleep podcast of gentle, unhurried episodes to help you fall asleep, made for insomnia and minds that won't switch off. You could count sheep, or let this show do the heavy yawning for you. Host Benjamin Boster reads slow-paced, fact-filled content on science, history, and everyday oddities with zero plot twists and even less urgency. It's calm. It's consistent. And yes, you might accidentally learn something. So get comfy, press play, and let your brain wander off without you.
